title: Unlocking Strain Analysis using MapSweeper
content: Pattern matching has been used for several years to optimize indexing for EBSD. AZtecCrystal MapSweeper utilizes a dynamic template matching approach, similar to dictionary indexing but without the need for a large library of patterns. As the name suggests dynamic template matching only creates patterns as they are required so 1000’s of patterns may be solved per second making MapSweeper a routine analysis tool in AZtecCrystal. Pattern Matching provides an improvement in angular precision from 0.1° (Hough) to < 0.01°. It can be used to overcome common challenges inherent in Hough based indexing, such as indexing poor quality EBSP’s and discrimination of phases with similar unit cells.
